name: Remove external exposure
credit_rule: Credit only when all public ingress paths to the vulnerable service are removed and verified.

name: Segmentation and restrictive ACLs
credit_rule: Credit only when every relevant path, including lateral movement, is blocked and tested.

name: Disable vulnerable service or feature
credit_rule: Strong credit requires vendor guidance and confirmation that the vulnerable path is unavailable.

name: Apply vendor workaround
credit_rule: Strong credit requires the exact Microsoft workaround and validation after deployment.

name: Exploit-specific IPS or NGFW rule
credit_rule: Credit requires a CVE-specific or exploit-specific signature in prevention mode with recent validation.

name: WAF virtual patch
credit_rule: Credit requires coverage of the vulnerable route and a tested blocking rule.

name: Protocol or feature hardening
credit_rule: Credit requires a setting that directly removes an exploit prerequisite.

name: Strong authentication and access restriction
credit_rule: Credit only when authentication gates the vulnerable path and bypass routes are excluded.

name: Least privilege and privileged access management
credit_rule: Primarily reduces consequence unless the exploit requires privileges that have been removed.

name: Application control or WDAC
credit_rule: Credit only when the inferred exploit chain depends on starting an untrusted executable or script.

name: Attack surface reduction rules
credit_rule: Credit requires a rule that maps to the inferred exploit technique and is enforced.

name: Email and web content filtering
credit_rule: Credit applies to user-delivered content only when the relevant file or URL path is blocked.

name: Office Protected View and macro hardening
credit_rule: Credit applies only to Office exploit paths addressed by the configured policy.

name: EDR exploit-specific prevention
credit_rule: Credit requires a tested prevention capability for the specific exploit behavior, not generic EDR presence.

name: EDR detection and response coverage
credit_rule: No likelihood credit by default. This improves detection and response confidence.

name: Immutable and tested backups
credit_rule: No likelihood credit. This may reduce availability consequences but not confidentiality or identity compromise.

name: Strong isolation or offline enclave
credit_rule: Credit requires verified isolation of every relevant ingress and administration path.
